Extract markdown-aware chunks and pass their content and metadata to your retrieval system.

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/markdown\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md\"}", "{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"markdown\",\"max_chars\":500,\"max_overlap\":50,\"trim\":true}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].chunks() as Any)
```
